Strategy: Combine the widened gentle fifteen sweet band gated behind ten open bins, an exact-fit bonus, and a three-or-four-more-items bonus with the mid penalty. This rewards a wider range of reusable leftovers at once, but the strict gate may rarely engage.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) + (15 if len(bins) >= 10 and r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 48 else 0) + (10 if r - item >= 3 * item and r - item < 5 * item else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
